subject: Math
prompt:
[Table 1]

A survey taken by $1,000$ community members asked whether they visit the local library at least once per week. The table above summarizes all $1,000$ responses from the community members surveyed. How many of the adults surveyed responded that they do not visit the library at least once per week?
explanation: Choice B is correct. The table summarizes all $1{,}000$ responses. If $285$ are adults who visit the library at least once per week, $190$ are teens who visit, and $175$ are teens who do not visit, then $1{,}000 - 285 - 190 - 175 = 350$ adults do not visit the library at least once per week.
